blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — San Juan City was recognized as one of the awardees under the Top Performing City category during the Department of the Interior and Local Government’s (DILG) 2026 NCR Subaybayani Awards, in recognition of its accomplishments in implementing locally funded infrastructure projects and strengthening local project monitoring mechanisms. Mayor Francis Zamora was represented by his son, Special Assistant to the Mayor Rocco Zamora, who received the award together with Vice Mayor Angelo Agcaoili during the awarding ceremony.
